immediate_outcome: The run inspector has a Reviews tab that renders retained kiln.patchgate.review.v1 receipts with distinct decisions, preserved identities and the verbatim native report.
surface: Run detail tab Reviews (data-view=reviews) over GET /api/runs/{id}/reports; no new endpoint, no dispatch, no mutation.
rendering_verified_with: The receipt retained by .cairn/changes/add-patchgate-review-adapter/evidence/native-smoke.json (case accepted), whose schema is kiln.patchgate.review.v1 and whose observation carries one pijul change decision.
observations: Tab set became Pipeline, Logs, Artifacts, Tests & coverage, Reviews, Compare & flaky, Activity, Evidence.

Receipt card showed effect review-accepted, candidate candidate-accepted, candidate root, pipeline revision, policy identity, provider profile, native binding, report identity, request identity, 2768 retained native-report bytes, the recorded local+UTC time and the source revision.

Decision badges showed "accepted · 1", "Acceptance authority: none" and "Isolated execution recorded"; the change table listed pijul/change/5QDXQLXYVM6L2GMM7QUOQW4DDABEZWAG6MBTON5Q45VSE6DKNO7AC as accepted.
The native report is available verbatim in a collapsed details block and is never re-serialized.
A real retained run without a patchgate receipt reported "No retained Patchgate review receipt for this run" instead of implying a clean review.
limits: No Patchgate executable is installed on this host and https://github.com/brittonr/patchgate returned HTTP 404, so no new live review was produced; the rendered receipt comes from the adapter pinned-producer smoke already retained in this change.
The view never dispatches Patchgate and cannot create, accept or reject a review.
non_claims: A displayed receipt proves only that Kiln admitted and preserved that evidence for the run. It is not review acceptance, merge authority, gate acceptance, source trust or release readiness.
